name: rolepod-seo
description: SEO + GEO + AEO site audit for AI coding agents — Quick or Full audit of a site across classic search (SEO), generative engines (GEO) and answer engines (AEO), scored 1–10 per dimension with quoted evidence, ending in a prioritized fix plan that hands off to rolepod-uiproof (rendered DOM, Core Web Vitals), rolepod-wplab (WordPress writes) and the rolepod parent roles. Skills only — no MCP server, no hooks.

interface.shortDescription: SEO + GEO + AEO site audit with scores, evidence and a fix plan — for AI coding agents.
interface.longDescription: rolepod-seo ships skills, not tools: /seo-audit runs a Quick (home + key pages) or Full (every meaningful page) audit across SEO, GEO (AI Overviews, ChatGPT search, Perplexity) and AEO (featured snippets, People Also Ask, voice). A stdlib-only collector fetches HTML, robots.txt and sitemaps into one table per page; the model scores each dimension 1–10 with the top findings that drove the score, every finding quoting the page and the tag. Output is a chat summary, a markdown report and a JSON sidecar with a stable shape. When rolepod-uiproof is installed the audit adds rendered-DOM and Core Web Vitals checks; WordPress fixes hand off to rolepod-wplab, code fixes to frontend-developer, copy to content-strategist. Zero per-session tool-schema cost.
defaultPrompt: Use /seo-audit to run a Quick audit of https://example.com and give me the three scores with evidence.
Use /seo-audit in Full mode on my site and write the report + JSON sidecar to reports/.
